hashes: Hashes of original bytes, except the dataset itself is hashed in MANIFEST.json. config_file_sha256 hashes frozen source config; config_sha256 hashes actual exported runtime configuration.
missing: JSON null means unavailable, not zero. Planned jobs remain even without a status/result. Failed and timed-out jobs are not reclassified as losses.
privacy: No observations, actions, controller event streams, game saves, raw logs, private absolute paths or host connection details.
resources: CPU/wall are per-game totals; summed wall is not elapsed batch time. RSS is worker-lifetime high-water mark, not isolated per-game peak.
row_unit: One attempt enumerated in an individual SDK batch manifest; batch+seed+side is the attempt key. logical_job_id groups only explicitly registered retries. Raw status is preserved; infrastructure_interrupted is a provenance-backed derived status, not a world outcome.
scope: All individual SDK research batch manifests. Combined scheduler manifests, retry-composed logical views, and replay-only audits are not duplicated. Official protocol reproductions appear separately and are not independent strength games.
score: Only completed games: W=1, D=0.5, L=0, from tested side. Time-limit majority-city wins are W, not necessarily unification.
status_priority: Per-game status.json, then batch results.json, otherwise not_started. Terminal records cross-checked when both present.
timing: SDK over-2s counters are measured decisions, not enforced JSONL protocol timeouts.
type: derived sanitized dataset, not a replacement for original evidence
